protocol.window_rule: Full-coverage, evenly spaced overlapping 10-second windows; ceil(music-duration/10) windows. Exclude 0.5-second release tail.
protocol.score_rule: Mean per-window cosine to normalized three-prompt genre mean; no softmax or 1-5 conversion.

validation_status: Inconclusive for final genre ratings; source-development 2-way agreement 2/4
external_reference_control_note: Two additional artist-labelled reference recordings matched the prompted genre; this does not validate the model on General MIDI project clips.
